purpose: Bounded ordered response study at fixed known price locations; no classifier or trading/account inference
history: All seen development histories. Prefix masking limits immediate hindsight only, not true blinding or OOS.
anchor_rule: First eligible price observation in case on/after requested anchor. Boundaries use preceding 21 eligible observations, excluding anchor. Window anchor through next20 observations, capped case end. No replacement if insufficient.
boundaries: upper=max(prior21 high), lower=min(prior21 low), frozen until observation window ends; no moving or fitting
price_clock: Finite positive OHLC with low<=open/close<=high, observed_bar true, synthetic_event_bar false; explicit source-invalid/zero-volume-flat placeholder rows excluded. Mere missing volume does not change price clock.
volume_reference: median finite positive volume among same prior21 price observations; fixed, missing volume unknown; q=volume/reference, continuous without high/low threshold
range: H=L retains valid price; close location undefined and explicitly marked. H>L location=(C-L)/(H-L). No inferred intraday order.
daily_facts: For each boundary: touch (upper H>=U/lower L<=D), close outside (>U/<D), touch-and-close-inside, consecutive outside, return inside after outside, recontact after at least one complete no-touch day. Full daily ledger for both sides; no trade or state labels.
manual_selection: Per case earliest boundary touch in window (both sides if simultaneous, same-day order unknown), plus first recontact of that same boundary after at least one whole no-touch observation. At most 2 selected event dates; other-side events stay in ledger. No touch => one end-window no-contact review. Exact duplicate symbol+effective-anchor+boundary definition only may be merged preserving membership; overlapping paths retained.
review_order: For each reviewer assigned batch: inspect and lock all P views, then all H, then all V, finally outcome charts/tables. P is closing response conditional on common OHLC boundaries, NOT independent price-only algorithm. H adds OHLC; V adds same-period volumes. Current judgments, alternatives and invalidation conditions saved before later stage. All prior histories already known.
display: Chart only prior21 boundary history and through selected event date. Axis limits depend only shown prefix. Outcome adds up to next5 eligible observations, bounded case end; +1/+5 labels separate from causal ledger. No-contact outcome absent.
interpretation: No-contact and censored cases retained; continuous outside is persistence not many breakouts; same-day boundary touch does not itself imply fakeout; high/low volume never automatically assigns healthy/distribution/accumulation.
failure_rules: No parameter, anchor or window changes after new results. No new model if only relabeling net displacement/wider hysteresis.
Distinguish additional OHLC observation from incremental volume. If volume changes narratives but not useful discrimination, say so.
If study misses known failure period, disclose insufficient coverage; do not extend chosen window for a prettier result.
No accounts, no rankings optimization, no networking or data refresh.
